source: Schiffy from pupkins.moku.gg (Moku-approved), extracted 2026-10-26: Asset Library/moku/pupkins-hub/schiffy/schiffy.glb (4,008 tris, 87 bones, PSPS_Idle + PSPS_Run) and whale-hub/dev/avatars/schiffy-clips.glb (clips only, same skeleton). Copied unchanged. The clips file is merged at load time (tracks bind by bone name).
note: look: 'toon' (Ruben 2026-10-26: same as the enemies = own textures, toon shading, ink hull at the enemies' world width 0.032 with welded smooth normals) = toon shading on the painted textures + ink hull, 'tex' = the GLB's own materials, 'texink' = own materials + ink hull (?look= overrides). clipFallback: an anim without a clip plays another anim's clip (fall holds the jump clip's last pose), with the code motion on top. outline.world = ink width in metres (the pup's 0.016 model units x its 2x scale), turned into mesh units at load. ?player=pup = the old pup.
